color_palette.instructions: Update index.css with these exact HSL variables in the :root and .dark scopes. Oxford Blue (#002147) and Highlighter Yellow (#D4FF00) form the academic/AI contrast. Never use purple or violet.

typography.instructions: Import Cabinet Grotesk from fontshare or standard CDN, IBM Plex Sans & JetBrains Mono from Google Fonts. Headings MUST be tightly tracked. Never use Inter for Headings.

spacing_and_layout.containers: Use p-6 to p-8 inside bordered containers to provide academic breathing room.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text and forms. Maintain strict optical alignment.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat solid background, 1px border (border-border), no shadow by default. Hover: shadow-sm border-primary/20 transition-all.
surface_strategies.headers: Solid background with a 1px bottom border. No transparent navs. Sticky z-50.
surface_strategies.interactive_elements: Neumorphism avoided. Use high-contrast solid colors and sharp 4px (0.25rem) radius.

shadcn_overrides.Card: Use minimal styling: bg-white border border-border rounded-md shadow-none.
shadcn_overrides.Tabs: Override default rounded pills with minimalist bottom-border active states (Notion-style). text-muted-foreground for inactive, border-b-2 border-primary text-primary for active.
shadcn_overrides.Input: bg-transparent border border-border focus:border-primary rounded-md transition-colors.

custom_elements.flashcards: Requires framer-motion 3D flip. Front is pure card bg, back is muted yellow/gray bg with answer.
custom_elements.quiz_options: Radio buttons customized as full-width clickable blocks. Active state: bg-accent/20 border-accent text-foreground.

components.instructions: Avoid overusing standard Shadcn 'Vercel' look. Strip heavy shadows. Use flat, bold styles.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Hover states must be explicitly styled (e.g. hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground).
motion_and_interactions.flashcard_flip: Use framer-motion for a realistic 3D rotateY flip animation on flashcards.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle fade and slide up (y: 10 -> 0) using framer-motion for dashboard components.

icons_and_assets.instructions: Use Phosphor Icons for a more academic/editorial look than default Lucide. Install: yarn add @phosphor-icons/react

auth_background.description: Abstract minimalist Swiss poster design, overlapping geometric shapes in Oxford Blue and bright yellow on bone white background. Use for Login/Signup split screen right side.

empty_state_learning.description: Clean minimalist illustration of an open book with floating glowing geometric shapes. Use for 'No lectures uploaded yet' or 'No active topics'.

teacher_dashboard_hero.description: Teacher giving lecture. Use as an avatar or a subtle header image in teacher profile.

student_studying.description: Focused student with headphones studying. Use for student dashboard welcome banner or empty state for quizzes.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, quiz options, flashcards) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute based on role.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Text over the highlighter yellow accent must be dark (foreground) for APCA/WCAG contrast.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. Update index.css with the exact HSL color palette provided in this JSON.
3. Add Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans fonts via HTML <link> or @import.
4. Build the Auth split screen using the `auth_background` image.
5. Build Teacher Dashboard using Bento Grid layout and strict data tables.
6. Build Student Viewer using Notion-style tabs for Transcript/Notes/Quiz/Flashcards.
7. Implement 3D flip card component for flashcards using framer-motion.
8. NEVER use generic placeholder images. Use ONLY the URLs provided.
